sentence: Add a Spanish language switch to the pick-up flow.
preservation: typed entry and session on switch
privacy reset of language with the session
reviewer_notes: Code facts read before running the skill: js/i18n.js already holds complete EN and ES string tables for every screen and dialog; app.js already has state.lang, applyLang(), a 'lang' action and a 'set-lang' chooser action; index.html <html lang> is updated on switch; resetSession() restores the default language for the next visitor. BUT the comment in i18n.js says 'the switcher lives on the attract screen only' and screens.js confirms it: the language toggle is rendered only in the attract foot / first-visit chooser. The utilbar (`utilbar()` in screens.js, present on every flow screen: accessible-mode toggle, Help, Start over; 3-column grid, 104 px tonal buttons, bottom reach zone) has no language control, so a visitor who touched Start in English cannot switch to Spanish on identify/list/confirm/done. Expected fix: reuse the existing 'lang' action and add a language control to the utilbar (4 columns, or a dedicated slot) on every flow screen; label it in the target language with a lang attribute ('Español' / 'English'); keep session, typed DOB/name, selection and error state across the switch (render() re-renders from session, so this should hold if the switch does not reset the session); keep keyboard/switch focus on the toggle after the full re-render (focusKeyOf covers data-action buttons); announce the change in a live region; keep every target >= 72 px (a11y >= 84 px) and >= 16 px gaps with four buttons in a 984 px row; Spanish labels are longer, so the 104 px util buttons must wrap or size without overflow in both standard and accessible mode; do not touch the idle/privacy timing from p5-12; language must still reset with the session. Should NOT add a settings page, a dropdown, flags, a route/URL change, or a TV/responsive treatment. Attract chooser and its behaviour stay as-is.
